description: Re-inject essential context after context compaction

SessionStart.command: if [ -f .claude/context-essentials.md ]; then cat .claude/context-essentials.md; else echo 'No context-essentials.md found. Create .claude/context-essentials.md with key architectural decisions, conventions, and current tasks.'; fi

sections: ## Current Tasks: What is being worked on

usage: Copy the SessionStart hook to .claude/settings.json. Create .claude/context-essentials.md with your project's critical context that must survive compaction.
